title: Differential compatibility of the explicit tuple-generator map
statement: For a scheme $X$, a family $f_i:U_i\to U_0$ in its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], a presheaf of rings $O$, and $W$, let $b_n$ be the explicit tuple-generator map of [lem-weil-pbc-free-cech-tuple-basis]. Let $K$ be the evaluated alternating free Cech complex. Then $d_{K,n}b_{n+1}=b_n d_{\mathrm{tuple},n}$ for all $n$, where $d_{\mathrm{tuple},n}$ is the blockwise alternating deletion differential [lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible]. No bijectivity or exactness is asserted.

source.place: Tag 03AT (lemma-cech-exact): direct-sum decomposition before the contracting homotopy; Tag 03F5 (lemma-cech-exact-modules): first proof, coefficients O(W). Sources read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03AT and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03F5

proof.text: On DFinsupp.single phi (Finsupp.single x r), the tuple map gives r times the product-map generator. The j-th face reindexes along Fin.succAbove j and postcomposes by the corresponding product projection. Pi.lift_π and product uniqueness identify this with the tuple generator after deletion of the j-th entry, preserving phi.

Expand the alternating differential into the finite sum of these faces. Its integer signs act as the corresponding powers of -1 in O(W). Thus both sides agree on each generator. By Finsupp and DFinsupp linear-map extensionality they agree everywhere, with no assumption on nonemptiness or commutativity of O(W).

mathlib_searches.query: The tuple-generator map from the direct sum of free modules on lifts to the evaluation of the free Cech complex is bijective and commutes with alternating differentials

from.place: degreewise tuple basis and differential compatibility in the comparison of complexes

lean.statement: theorem freeCechDifferential_compatibility (X : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Type u) (U₀ : X.Etale) (U : ι → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : ι, U i ⟶ U₀) (O : X.Etaleᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}) (W : X.Etale) : let M := freeCechModule X ι U₀ U f O let K := (((PresheafOfModules.evaluation O (op W)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj ((AlgebraicTopology.alternatingFaceMapComplex _).obj M)) let b := freeCechTupleMap X ι U₀ U f O W let D := fun n ↦ DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap (fun φ ↦ Algebra.powerSetComplexDifferential (O.obj (op W)) (freeCechLifts X ι U₀ U f W φ) n) ∀ n, (K.d (n + 1) n).hom.comp (b (n + 1)) = (b n).comp (D n)
